name: Thursday Mountain Bike Ride in Frick Park (3 Rivers Outdoor Co)
schedule: Every Thursday, 6:00 pm (meet at the shop), May 21 to Oct 29, 2026, weather and trail conditions permitting. Ride leaders are needed.
pace: Intermediate to difficult; the shop says it can adapt the ride for different skill levels
visitor_notes: Helmets are mandatory. Bring water, snacks and spare tubes. Knobby tires, suspension and disc brakes are strongly encouraged. Sign the waiver on the shop's page. The shop posts cancellations on Facebook or Instagram.
description: A free weekly mountain bike ride from the shop's front door in Regent Square into Frick Park. The trails are steep with roots, rocks and obstacles. It runs one to two hours and the distance varies. Rental bikes are offered through Golden Triangle Bikes.
evidence: The shop's event page lists a weekly Frick Park ride, Thursday May 21 to Thursday Oct 29, 2026, 6:00 to 8:00 pm, from 1130 S. Braddock Ave (read Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The listing runs to Oct 29, 2026. Expect it to roll over in May 2027. Cancellations go on the shop's Facebook and Instagram.

name: Whatever Weds (Pgh Babes on Bikes)
schedule: Wednesdays, 6:00 pm, April to August. Routes and pace change each week with the ride leader. 2026 dates ran from Apr 22; the page lists Aug 5, 12, 19 and 26 as the last.
pace: Usually B pace; some weeks B+ with hills
visitor_notes: A W+ ride. The group's 2025 post says it rolls at 6 pm from Kindred Cycles; the 2026 events page lists dates only, so check the group's Instagram for the start and for rain cancellations (thunderstorms have cancelled rides). The group posts the route, leader and pace for each week.
description: A weekly women-plus group ride that leaves from Kindred Cycles in the Strip District. The vibe depends on the ride leader: sometimes a set route, sometimes wherever the green lights go. The series runs spring to late summer and is off for the fall and winter.
evidence: The group's events page lists Whatever Wednesday for every Wednesday from Apr 22 through Jul 29, 2026 and upcoming Aug 5, 12, 19 and 26 (read Oct 2, 2026). The 6 pm Kindred Cycles start is from the group's 2025 launch post.

refresh.notes: The events page lists the Wednesdays under Repeating Events ('seasonal'). The series restarts in April; look for the first post in March.

status_note: The 2026 series ran April to August. The group has not posted a 2027 start. In 2025 it began Apr 2 and in 2026 on Apr 22.

name: Critical Mass Pittsburgh
schedule: Second Friday of every month, rain or shine. The shop's calendar lists 6:30 pm from Friendship Park.
visitor_notes: The shop's listing says rain or shine. Ike's Basement Bike Shop posts the dates on its calendar. Confirm the start before a first ride; the page lists a 6:30 pm start and a 10:00 pm end.
description: A monthly group ride through Pittsburgh on the second Friday. The shop that lists it calls it slow, steady and raucous, with community and joy as resistance. The calendar entries run from 6:30 pm at Friendship Park.
evidence: Ike's Basement Bike Shop's event page says 'Critical Mass - PGH, 2nd Friday of every month (rain or shine!)' and lists Jan 9 through May 8, 2026 at 6:30 pm from Friendship Park (read Oct 2, 2026). The page does not list dates after May.

refresh.notes: The shop's page lists dates only to May 2026. BikePGH's Other Local Cycling Calendars page says last Friday, Carnegie Library, Oakland; that is old. Confirm on Instagram before a first ride.

name: Cape Cod NEMBA Monthly Chapter Ride and Meeting
schedule: Usually the second Tuesday of the month, 5:30 pm: ride, then food and a chapter meeting. The place changes each month. Next: Tue Oct 13, 2026, Beebe Woods and Long Pond, from Goodwill Park, Falmouth; then Tue Nov 10 (Tavern on the Green, Marstons Mills).

start_location.name: Goodwill Park (Oct 13); the place changes each month

visitor_notes: The chapter says rides and meetings are open to all, and asks riders to join NEMBA. The 2026 list has exceptions: April's is on a Thursday and there is a May 16 Spring Fling.
description: The Cape Cod chapter of the New England Mountain Bike Association rides a different trail system each month, then eats and holds its chapter meeting. The 2026 list runs March to November and names the trail and the start for each one.
evidence: The chapter's '2026 Chapter Meetings and Rides' page (posted Jan 15, 2026) lists Tue Oct 13, 5:30 pm, Beebe Woods from Goodwill Park, Falmouth; NEMBA's chapter page lists the same ride Oct 13, 5:30 to 8:30 pm (both read Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The chapter posts the year's list each January. NEMBA's chapter page (nemba.org/chapters/cape-cod-nemba) shows the next dated event.

name: Wachusett NEMBA Monday Night Ride
schedule: Mondays, 6:00 to 8:00 pm, from Apr 20, 2026; the place changes each week. NEMBA's page lists Oct 5 (Leominster State Forest, Elm St lot), Oct 12 (Lunenburg), Oct 19 (Holden, River Rd) and Oct 26 (Rutland, Ware River Watershed).

start_location.name: Changes weekly; Oct 5: Leominster State Forest, Elm St lot

visitor_notes: Register on the chapter's NEMBA event page. Seven Hills Wheelmen also lists the ride, starting Apr 20, 2026, and sends riders to the chapter's Facebook page.
description: The Wachusett chapter of the New England Mountain Bike Association rides a different trail in north-central Massachusetts each Monday evening. The October list covers Leominster, Lunenburg, Holden and Rutland.
evidence: NEMBA's Wachusett chapter page lists Monday Night Rides on Oct 5, 12, 19 and 26, 2026, 6 to 8 pm, each with a start address (read Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The chapter page shows the next four dated Mondays with their start addresses. The series likely stops for winter; look for it again in April.

name: Single Track Sisters Wednesday Women's Mountain Bike Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, 6:00 pm. The place changes each week around Portland, Windham or Falmouth; it is posted in the group's Facebook group.
pace: 10 to 15 miles; advanced ride, but many beginners join and the group sometimes holds impromptu rides of other levels
visitor_notes: Join the group's Facebook group to see each week's place. CycleMania also tells riders to check the Single Track Sisters Facebook page, or call the shop and ask for Deanna.
description: A women's mountain biking group that rides weekly on Wednesday evenings at a different trail each week around Greater Portland. Rides are usually about two hours and 10 to 15 miles. The group says it has many beginners.
evidence: The Portland Press Herald's '12 group bicycle rides in Greater Portland' (posted Aug 17, updated Aug 19, 2026) says the Single Track Sisters host a weekly ride on Wednesdays at 6 p.m. (read Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The Facebook group needs a login, so a robot cannot read it. The Press Herald guide is dated Aug 2026.

name: The Wednesday Morning Ride (Lehigh Valley Cycling Club)
schedule: Wednesdays, about 9:00 am, weather permitting during the riding season. Start, route and pace are posted on each Meetup event. Listed Oct 14, 2026.
season: Weather permitting during the riding season
visitor_notes: Weather permitting during the riding season. The host posts the start, route and pace on each Meetup event a few days ahead; Meetup asks riders not to RSVP until those details are up. LVCC says a first ride can be done as a non-member (sign in at the ride); after that riders must join LVCC.
description: A weekday-morning social road ride from the Lehigh Valley Cycling Club. The host of the day sets the route, the rest stop and the pace and posts them on Meetup before the ride. LVCC's rides cover Lehigh, Northampton and Berks counties.
evidence: LVCC's Meetup feed lists 'The Wednesday Morning Ride' for Wed Oct 14, 2026 at 9:00 am with a placeholder route and no start place (read Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The feed holds about ten events. The start place is filled in a few days before each ride.

name: The Friday Morning Ride (Lehigh Valley Cycling Club)
schedule: Fridays, about 9:00 am, weather permitting during the riding season. Start, route and pace are posted on each Meetup event. Listed Oct 9 and 16, 2026.
season: Weather permitting during the riding season
visitor_notes: Weather permitting during the riding season. The host posts the start, route and pace on each Meetup event a few days ahead; Meetup asks riders not to RSVP until those details are up. LVCC says a first ride can be done as a non-member (sign in at the ride); after that riders must join LVCC.
description: A Friday-morning social road ride from the Lehigh Valley Cycling Club. The host of the day sets the route and the pace and posts them on Meetup before the ride.
evidence: LVCC's Meetup feed lists 'The Friday Morning Ride' for Fri Oct 9 and Fri Oct 16, 2026 at 9:00 am with a placeholder route and no start place (read Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The feed holds about ten events. The start place is filled in a few days before each ride.

name: Dam Good Watts Monday Mountain Bike Ride
schedule: Mondays, 6:00 pm, from the Housley Rd trailhead of the Annapolis Waterworks Trail. ABRT's rides page says March through October; ABRT's public calendar has no end date and says it goes year round, even in the dark. Trail conditions decide.

start_location.name: Annapolis Waterworks Trail, Housley Rd trailhead (near the PetSmart)

pace: As fast or slow as you want; one counter-clockwise lap of Waterworks Park; slower riders can cut the deeper loops
visitor_notes: You can be dropped, but the group tries to have a sweeper and sometimes regroups at the dam. Bring good lights for dark rides. For weather cancellations see the group's Instagram. Some riders park in west Annapolis near Chessie's Wharf for extra road miles.
description: A friendly Monday evening mountain bike lap of Annapolis Waterworks Park, starting and ending at the Housley trailhead. It takes 60 to 90 minutes. ABRT's pages list it as an open ride; ABRT does not sanction it.
evidence: ABRT's public Google Calendar holds a weekly Monday 6:00 pm 'Dam Good Watts Ride' at 2607 Housley Rd with no end date, and its training-rides page (2026 footer) lists it Mondays 6:00 pm March through October (both read Oct 2, 2026). Neither carries a dated 2026 ride.

refresh.notes: The Google Calendar series was created June 2025 and repeats every Monday. The two ABRT sources disagree on season; the group's Instagram posts cancellations.

name: Monday FUNday Salem Group Ride (Trek Roanoke)
schedule: Mondays, 5:45 pm. The route changes weekly. Two rides: social pace and intermediate pace.

start_location.name: Olde Salem Brewery, back parking lot

pace: Social pace (leisurely) or intermediate pace (a bit faster)
visitor_notes: All types of bikes are welcome, says the guide. Both rides are strictly no-drop.
description: A Monday evening road ride from the Olde Salem Brewery parking lot, put on by Trek Roanoke. There are two rides to choose from and the route changes each week.
evidence: Roanoke Outside's guide 'Group bike rides for every day of the week' (updated June 8, 2026) lists Monday FUNday Mondays at 5:45 pm from Olde Salem Brewery, strictly no-drop (read Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: A Roanoke Outside guide, updated June 2026. Trek Roanoke also posts on Facebook.

name: But Coffee First Saturday Ride
schedule: Saturdays, 9:30 am, from Cardinal Bicycle in Grandin Village. A 30 to 40 mile route at 14 to 16 mph.
pace: Intermediate; keep a 14 to 16 mph pace
visitor_notes: You can get breakfast before or after at the Cardinal Cafe, which opens at 9:00 am. The guide does not name a host; the ride meets at the shop.
description: A Saturday road ride for intermediate riders from Grandin Village, 30 to 40 miles around Roanoke at 14 to 16 mph. The Cardinal Cafe next door opens at 9:00 am for breakfast.
evidence: Roanoke Outside's guide (updated June 8, 2026) lists But Coffee First Saturdays at 9:30 am from Cardinal Bicycle Grandin, 30 to 40 miles at 14 to 16 mph (read Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: A Roanoke Outside guide, updated June 2026. Cardinal Bicycle's own weekly rides page may also list it.

name: M&M MTB Sunday Ride
schedule: Sundays, 9:30 am, from the Bennett Springs parking lot at Carvins Cove. Riders split into groups by ability.

start_location.name: Bennett Springs parking lot, Carvins Cove

visitor_notes: The guide calls it a welcoming group that shares a love of mountain biking and the outdoors.
description: A Sunday morning mountain bike ride at Carvins Cove that splits into groups by ability. It meets at the Bennett Springs lot.
evidence: Roanoke Outside's guide (updated June 8, 2026) lists M&M MTB Ride Sundays at 9:30 am from the Bennett Springs lot at Carvins Cove (read Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: A Roanoke Outside guide, updated June 2026. The group's own page is a Facebook group.

name: Pride Rides Vermont Group Rides
schedule: Posted date by date on the group's public calendar, mostly on weekend days. 2026 rides so far: Jan 18, Feb 11, May 1, May 30, Aug 9, Aug 14, Aug 15 and 16, Sept 27. The next ride is not posted yet. The time and start are on each calendar entry.

start_location.name: Changes with each ride; see the calendar entry

pace: All levels, per the calendar entries
visitor_notes: Check the calendar for the start and the level of each ride. Some rides are in Vermont and some are not (Aug 9 was in New Hampshire). Cancelled rides, such as Jan 24 in -30 wind chill, are marked on the calendar.
description: A Vermont nonprofit that holds group rides for LGBTQIA+ riders: mountain bike, gravel and road paths. The rides move around the state and are posted one at a time on a public calendar. The group's site says it exists to create a space to ride without having to hide.
evidence: The group's public Google Calendar, embedded on prideridesvt.org, lists Pride Rides on Aug 9, 14, 15, 16 and Sept 27, 2026 (Burlington path ride, 10:15 am roll), and none after that (read Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The feed also holds old events from 2020 to 2025; read only the future ones. Rides are irregular, about one to three a month in season.

name: Vino Velo
schedule: Saturdays, 9:00 am from Lloyd Hall on Boathouse Row to Ambler and back, 35 to 40 miles. The organizer's Strava club says the main group leaves at 9:05 and the race-pace group at 9:00.
pace: Fast. QCW's list says 'they will not wait', and a more casual group often rolls out just behind the A group
visitor_notes: A long-running fast training ride. The club's description says it was revived as a group ride, not a race. Know the route, and expect to be dropped if you cannot hold the pace.
description: A long-standing Saturday morning road ride from the Art Museum area to Ambler and back. It has fast sections and sprints, and a casual group often follows the A group. QCW Cycling lists it among area rides and The Trellis lists it in its October 2026 calendar.
evidence: The Trellis's Philly Bike Events Calendar, showing events from October to December 2026, lists Vino Velo under Saturday as an A and A- ride from Boathouse Row to Ambler; the ride's Strava club and QCW's Area Rides page give the 9:00 and 9:05 am times (all read Oct 2, 2026; the Strava and QCW pages carry no date).

refresh.notes: The Strava club's event list needs a login. The Trellis calendar is edited by hand. Confirm on the club page before a first ride.

name: Mountain Espresso (PAPERtrail Bike Cafe)
schedule: Saturdays, 8:00 am, 10 miles of the Orange, White and Yellow trails in Wissahickon Valley Park. The Trellis calendar says dates alternate, so confirm with the shop.
pace: Intermediate and advanced riders are encouraged; regulars lead and sweep
visitor_notes: The shop rents full-suspension Salsa mountain bikes. Free espresso at the shop after the ride.
description: A Saturday morning mountain bike ride in Wissahickon Valley Park from the PAPERtrail Bike Cafe. The shop calls it a no-drop ride with regulars to lead and sweep, and gives free espresso back at the shop.
evidence: The shop's Espresso Rides page says Mountain Espresso Saturday at 8am, 10 miles of Wissahickon trails (undated page), and The Trellis's October 2026 calendar lists 'PAPERtrail Mountain Espresso, dates alternate' (both read Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The shop's page has no dates. Its Instagram posts updates. The shop's events calendar feed was empty.

name: NCVC Espresso Ride
schedule: Sundays, 9:15 am in winter and 8:45 am in summer, from High Road Cycling in Georgetown. NCVC does not say when the winter time starts, so be there by 8:45 and check the club's Instagram. 47.8 miles, 1,520 ft of climbing.
visitor_notes: NCVC says coming along to its listed rides is the best way to introduce yourself, and that its Facebook and Instagram are the most up to date source; check there before a first visit. Wear a helmet and ride sensibly.
description: The National Capital Velo Club's long Sunday road ride from Georgetown, 47.8 miles with 1,520 feet of climbing. The club's team page lists it as a ride guests can join.
evidence: NCVC's Rides page lists the Espresso Ride Sundays at 9:15 am (winter) or 8:45 am (summer) from High Road Cycling, Georgetown, 47.8 miles (read Oct 2, 2026; the page is undated).

refresh.notes: The page has no dates and no winter start date. The club says its Instagram and Facebook are the most current.

name: Sutton Bike Works Monday Rides
schedule: Mondays, 6:00 pm, about 22 miles, from the shop. Seven Hills Wheelmen's list gives it as a 2026 ride; the shop's Strava club has the details and RSVP.
visitor_notes: Seven Hills Wheelmen says to call ahead to confirm its listings. The shop's Strava club says 'Weekly shop rides!' and the March 2026 news story about the shop says weekly road, mountain and gravel rides were planned. Evening light is short by October.
description: A weekly Monday evening shop ride of about 22 miles from Sutton Bike Works in Millbury. The shop's Strava club is the place to RSVP.
evidence: Seven Hills Wheelmen's recurring rides page lists '6 p.m. Mondays (2026), Sutton Bike Works rides, 4 South Main St., Millbury, 22 miles'; the shop's Strava club says 'Weekly shop rides!' (club events need a login); a Mar 25, 2026 article says the shop planned weekly group rides (all read Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The club's event list needs a login and the shop's site lists no ride. Confirm with the shop or the Strava club before a first visit.

name: Wednesday Night Rides (814 Outdoor Sports)
schedule: Wednesdays, 6:00 pm sharp, April to October. Most nights have A, B, C and D groups.

start_location.name: 814 Outdoor Sports parking lot
start_location.address: 500 West Plum Street, Suite A, Edinboro, PA 16412

pace: A, B, C and D groups
visitor_notes: Bike Erie's page lists the Edinboro Wednesday rides at 6 pm from the lot behind Sox Harrison Stadium on the Edinboro University campus, with helmets mandatory and lights recommended in early and late season. The shop's own page says its parking lot. Ask the shop (814-737-0818) which start is current.
description: A long-running Wednesday evening group ride from the 814 Outdoor Sports shop in Edinboro, dating back to the days of Countryside Cycling. It splits into A through D groups most nights.
evidence: The shop's Group Rides page says Wednesday night rides run April to October and leave promptly at 6pm from its parking lot; Bike Erie's rides page also lists Edinboro Wednesdays at 6:00 pm (both read Oct 2, 2026; neither is dated).

refresh.notes: Neither page carries a date. The two pages give different start places. Calling the shop settles it.
